description: 13 active initiatives with 10 at 0% completion. Velocity proves focused execution works (feature-parity went 0->57% when focused). Revenue critical path is ~11 items across 3 initiatives. State persistence has failed 3+ heartbeats — decisions keep getting lost.

options.label: Tight revenue-first (3 Active Now)
options.rationale: Active Now: swarm-manager-feature-parity (3 items, 57% done), desktop-release-governance (6 items, revenue gate), desktop-monetization-assurance (2 items, revenue gate). Track: brand-manager-readiness, dtv-meta-optimization-readiness, rapid-approval-flow. Defer all 7 others. Total active items: 11. ~4 weeks to revenue.

options.label: Revenue-first + momentum (4 Active Now)
options.rationale: Same as A but promote brand-manager-readiness to Active Now. Total active: 15 items. Adds branding but not strictly on revenue path.

options.label: Status quo (13 active)
options.rationale: Keep all 13. Evidence: 0% on 10/13. Not recommended.

description: Portfolio has grown from 11 to 13 initiatives over recent heartbeats while completion rate remains under 10%. No initiative has ever been completed.

options.label: Moratorium on new initiatives
options.rationale: No new initiatives until swarm-manager-feature-parity completes (3 items left). New ideas as standalone backlog items only. Prevents further dilution.

options.label: No moratorium
options.rationale: Allow new initiatives. Risk: further dilution.

description: Decisions, tasks, and knowledge have been empty for 3+ consecutive heartbeats. Retention config is generous. Pruner finds nothing. State is either never written or overwritten. Without persistent state the director is trapped in infinite re-analysis.

options.label: Investigate and fix persistence
options.rationale: Root-cause the write path for prompt-manager shared state files. Check if heartbeat lifecycle overwrites on start or if writes fail silently. This is P0 because it blocks all strategic continuity.

topic: Triage 2 failed backlog items blocking completion
description: Two items have failed status: (1) swarm-manager-identity-adoption — dependency cli-core-identity-consumer is completed, so this failed during execution. This blocks app-issue-tracker-deprecation and thus feature-parity completion. (2) desktop-post-publish-version-sync — failed, outside the initiative item list but tagged to desktop-release-governance. Both need investigation and retry.

options.label: Deploy debug team for identity-adoption retry
options.rationale: Identity-adoption dep is satisfied. Retry execution. If it completes, deprecation chore becomes unblocked and feature-parity can finish (first initiative completion). Highest leverage action.

options.label: Descope identity-adoption from feature-parity
options.rationale: Remove identity-adoption and deprecation from the initiative, declare feature-parity complete at 5/5. Loses provenance tracking but unblocks the first completion milestone.

options.label: Investigate both failures before deciding
options.rationale: Root-cause both failures first, then decide retry vs descope. Slower but more informed.

topic: Updated Portfolio Focus: Completion-First Then Revenue
description: Portfolio has grown to 15 active initiatives (2 new: vrooli-events, notification-hub-greenfield). Total items: 92, completed: 20 (21.7%). vrooli-events demonstrated extraordinary velocity (2/4 in ~1 day). Feature-parity is 1 failed retry + 1 chore from first-ever initiative completion. Agent execution success rate is 0% (13/13 failures). Revenue path is 6 items across governance + monetization-assurance (~3-4 weeks if focused). Previous portfolio focus decision (dec-1775254772312319062) needs updating because vrooli-events did not exist when it was drafted.

options.label: Completion-first then revenue
options.rationale: NOW = feature-parity (retry identity-adoption + deprecation chore) and vrooli-events (2 items left). NEAR = governance (4 items), monetization-assurance (2 items), brand-manager-readiness (3 items). FAR = all 10 others. First-ever initiative completion validates the model. vrooli-events is 2 items from done with fastest velocity. Two completions this week would be transformative. Revenue path follows immediately after.

options.label: Revenue-first + momentum (4 Active NOW)
options.rationale: feature-parity, governance, monetization-assurance, vrooli-events all active. Track: brand-manager, dtv, rapid-approval. Defer 8 others. ~17 active items. Starts revenue and completion paths simultaneously. Risk: wider focus may slow both.

options.label: Strict revenue-only (3 Active NOW)
options.rationale: feature-parity, governance, monetization-assurance. Track vrooli-events. Defer everything else. ~11 items. Narrowest revenue focus. Risk: vrooli-events momentum wasted.

description: All 13 recorded agent executions have failed (0% success rate, avg 4.7 min runtime). This is a systemic portfolio-level risk. The recursive improvement thesis is blocked until this is resolved.

options.label: Investigate agent execution failures as P0
options.rationale: Root-cause why all 13 executions failed. Check agent-manager logs, execution records, swarm-manager history. Likely candidates: sandbox issues, timeout config, missing deps, or prompt issues. This is a gate for all timeline estimates.

options.label: Accept human-only execution
options.rationale: Acknowledge agent execution is broken, plan all work assuming human-driven completion. Abandons recursive improvement model.

topic: NOT_FOUND Dependency Hygiene: 5 Missing Items Block 8 Downstream
description: 5 backlog items referenced as dependencies do not exist: fix/dtv-validation-api, fix/web-console-tts-summarization-bug, research/prompt-manager-rapid-approval-ux, execute/swarm-manager-topology-impact-views, execute/swarm-manager-flow-and-ops-views. These block 8 downstream items across 4 initiatives.

options.label: Create or correct the 5 missing references
options.rationale: Audit each NOT_FOUND reference, determine if renamed (fix ref) or never created (create or remove dep). Backlog hygiene, not new scope.

options.label: Defer — all in FAR initiatives
options.rationale: All affected initiatives are deferred under portfolio focus. Fix when they move to NEAR/NOW.

description: Portfolio expanded to 22 initiatives with zero completions this week. Completion rate dropped from 21.7% to ~17%. 6 new initiatives added by human during moratorium gap. Agent execution still 0%. Strategist recommends completion sprint.

options.label: Completion Sprint
options.rationale: NOW: feature-parity (2 items = first completion), graph-workspace (2 items = second). NEAR: vrooli-events (2 items = third), governance (4 items). FAR: all 18 others including GCT. First completion ~1 week, revenue ~3-4 weeks.

options.label: Balanced Two-Track
options.rationale: NOW: feature-parity + governance. NEAR: vrooli-events, graph-workspace, monetization. FAR: GCT + 13 others. First completion ~1-2 weeks, revenue ~5-6 weeks.

options.label: Energy-Follow
options.rationale: NOW: whatever human is energized on (GCT). NEAR: feature-parity, graph-workspace. FAR: revenue. First completion ~2-3 weeks, revenue ~8-12 weeks.

topic: Moratorium revision: shift to execution-priority discipline
description: Moratorium (dec-1775254774942113200) was never approved. 6 new initiatives created in the gap. Pending decisions have zero enforcement power. Strategist recommends shifting from creation prevention to execution priority.

options.label: Execution-priority discipline
options.rationale: Abandon moratorium. New initiatives default to FAR tier, only NOW-tier gets execution attention. Realistic and focuses discipline where it matters.

options.label: Hard gate in swarm-manager
options.rationale: Prevent initiative creation programmatically when moratorium active. Effective but requires code changes.

options.label: Keep moratorium as advisory
options.rationale: Lowest friction, lowest effectiveness. Status quo.

description: swarm-manager-mobile-graph-interaction has archived_at timestamp (2026-03-30) but is counted as pending in initiative rollup. Is graph-workspace 5/7 or effectively 6/7? Director ruling needed to get accurate completion picture.

options.label: Re-activate mobile-graph-interaction
options.rationale: Un-archive and execute. Keeps initiative scope complete. M effort.

options.label: Remove from initiative, close at 6/6
options.rationale: Formally remove. Initiative is 1 item from completion (legacy cleanup only). Fastest path to completion.
